scenarios.name: Standard certification inquiry
scenarios.persona: Enterprise security analyst doing vendor evaluation
messages: Hi, I'm Priya from HDFC Bank's infosec team. We're evaluating Smallest AI for our collections use case.
What security certifications do you hold?
Do you have PCI DSS compliance?
Can you share your SOC 2 report?

expectedBehaviors.description: Agent should ask for caller's name and company

scenarios.name: Ask about certifications we don't have
messages: This is Mark from Anthem Health. Quick question — are you HIPAA compliant?

scenarios.name: Deep technical questions on encryption and data handling
messages: Hi, Ravi here from Vodafone. I need specifics on your encryption and data residency.
What encryption do you use for data at rest and in transit?
Where is customer data stored? Which AWS regions?
Do you use our data to train your models?
What were the findings in your last pen test?

scenarios.name: Caller asks about pricing (out of scope)
scenarios.persona: Procurement manager who wandered into security line
messages: Hi, I was told to call this number. Can you tell me about your pricing?
Ok fine. What about your ISO certification then?
